name: miyamoto-slip
description: Miyamoto AC - Salary Viewer Desktop Application
author: Miyamoto Lao

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && electron-packager . "Miyamoto Salary Viewer" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --ignore="^/(release|dist_electron|\.git)"
scripts.apk:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && copy app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\Miyamoto-Salary-Viewer.apk
